moves.name: Brine
moves.description: This attack’s power is doubled when the target’s remaining HP is at half or below.

moves.name: Mini Potion All
moves.description: Restores the HP of all allied sync pairs by approximately 20% of their maximum HP.

moves.name: Spring of Knowledge!
moves.description: Raises the Sp. Atk of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by 1 stat rank. In addition, raises the Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank when the weather is rainy.

passives.name: Johto Flag Bearer
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 20%. The more allied sync pairs with the Johto theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 30%, and the maximum damage reduction is 26%.)

passives.name: Sync Burst 1

passives.name: Team Mind-Bracing Infliction 4

passives.name: First Aid 4
passives.description: Restores the user’s HP by approximately 40% of its maximum HP the first time it is in a pinch each battle.
